findings.evidence: Line 41: `{K : Type*} [Field K] [NeZero (2 : K)]`; the docstring never mentions characteristic.
findings.fix: State the hypothesis: "A square-closed field of characteristic `≠ 2` has no nontrivial …".
findings.issue: Docstring "A square-closed field has no nontrivial finite Galois extension whose Galois group is a 2-group" omits the `NeZero (2 : K)` hypothesis and is false without it: `F₂` is square-closed (0=0*0, 1=1*1) and `F₄/F₂` is Galois with group `C₂`, `finrank = 2`.

findings.evidence: Line 173 `[Field K] [NeZero (2 : K)]`; line 156 `splits_quadratic_iff_isSquare` docstring begins "Over a field of characteristic `≠ 2`", and line 188 notes `discrim a b c = b²` is automatically a square in char 2.
findings.fix: Prefix with "Over a field of characteristic `≠ 2`," as the neighbouring lemmas do.
findings.issue: "A quadratic polynomial whose discriminant is a square has a root" omits `NeZero (2 : K)` and is false in characteristic 2: `discrim a b c = b²` is always a square there, yet `X² + X + 1` over `F₂` has no root.

findings.evidence: Mathlib's analogue documents the direction explicitly: `Mathlib/Topology/Order/IntermediateValue.lean:583` "case `f a ≤ t ≤ f b`", with a separate `intermediate_value_Icc'`.
findings.fix: Restrict the docstring to the case it proves, e.g. "**Intermediate value theorem** for polynomials on a closed interval, case `p.eval a ≤ y ≤ p.eval b`."
findings.issue: "Every value between the endpoint values is attained on the closed interval" overclaims: the statement is `Icc (p.eval a) (p.eval b) ⊆ p.eval '' Icc a b`, which is vacuous when `p.eval b < p.eval a`, and no `'`-variant is provided.

findings.evidence: Lines 34-47: the statement is the mean value equality; the docstring only narrates the secant-subtraction proof step.
findings.fix: State the result: polynomial Rolle implies the mean value equality `p.eval b - p.eval a = p.derivative.eval c * (b - a)` for some `c ∈ Ioo a b`.
findings.issue: `Rolle.mean_value`'s docstring "Subtracting the secant line reduces polynomial mean value to Rolle" describes the proof, not the result.

findings.evidence: Line 26 `scoped instance {R : Type*} [Field R] [IsSemireal R] : Fact (¬ IsSquare (-1 : R))` with no preceding `/-- -/`.
findings.fix: Add a docstring stating that a formally real field has `-1` a non-square, supplying the `Fact` that makes `QuadraticAlgebra R (-1) 0` a field.
findings.issue: Anonymous exported (scoped) instance `Fact (¬ IsSquare (-1 : R))` is undocumented; nothing says why it is needed.

findings.evidence: Line 31 `theorem exists_nonneg_sq {a : R} (ha : 0 ≤ a) : ∃ r : R, 0 ≤ r ∧ r ^ 2 = a` inside `public section`, no docstring.
findings.fix: Document it: every nonnegative element of a real closed field has a nonnegative square root.
findings.issue: Public theorem `exists_nonneg_sq` has no docstring, although it is the file's square-root API used by `complex_isSquare` and (via `Icc` arguments) elsewhere.

findings.evidence: Line 15: `/-! # Finite extensions of an abstract real closed field -/` — the whole docstring, for a file with two public theorems; compare `RealClosure/Basic.lean:13-28`, which names its declarations.
findings.fix: Add a body naming the two results and their role in bounding degrees of extensions of a real closed field.
findings.issue: Module docstring is a bare title; it does not say what material lives in the file or what it feeds (the odd-degree triviality and the no-quadratic-extension lemma consumed by the Sylow argument in `Galois.lean`).

findings.evidence: Line 12: `/-! # The Galois-theoretic reduction for real closed fields -/`, for a file with three public theorems.
findings.fix: Add a body naming the results and how they feed `AlgebraicClosed.lean`.
findings.issue: Module docstring is a bare title, with no statement of what the file contains (Galois group is a 2-group; triviality over a square-closed intermediate field) or what uses it.

findings.evidence: Lines 15-17: heading immediately followed by "Irreducible factors have degree at most two; …"; the three IVT theorems at lines 125, 140, 148 are unmentioned.
findings.fix: Insert the blank line after the `#` heading and state what the file provides (polynomial IVT in sign-change and image-inclusion form, plus the constant-sign lemma reused by `AbstractRolle.lean`).
findings.issue: Module docstring body is only a proof outline and names none of the file's results (`ivt`, `ivt_of_mul_neg`, `Polynomial.intermediate_value_Icc`); it also lacks the blank line after the heading, so the outline runs into the title.

summary: Several docstrings drop the characteristic-≠-2 hypothesis and are false as worded, one docstring describes the proof instead of the result, the `intermediate_value_Icc` docstring omits its directional case, two new files have title-only module docstrings, and two public declarations in `Complexification.lean` are undocumented.
